claim.adversary: ROBUST within the tested caller-precomputed projection publication contract
claim.scope: Both part writers publish Wide and Compact children with their own schemas and granule grids. The existing encoders and readback checks run within one unpublished parent directory. The parent binds each child manifest and physical file roster before exclusive publication.
claim.remaining: General key schemas, additional physical layout and type products, automatic projection computation and maintenance, projection children from the caller-run MV transform, and performance.

risk.strongest_failure: A child accepted by Crystal fails native validation, or a late child failure leaves a partially published parent.
checks: Require ClickHouse to attach and check both generated mixed pairs, compare exact RowBinary with the literal rows, and verify the named projection in the forced plan.
Exercise both same-layout and both mixed pairs, the MRK3 child roster, distinct parent and child grids, mixed siblings, duplicate names, and detached input owners.

Give Wide and Compact children a shared read budget distinct from the write budget. Each child and the parent fit in isolation. Together they fail during the second child's readback and remove the whole staging tree.
risk.rollback: Revert the feature commit to remove the write API extension. Existing parts are untouched by the writer, and a failed publication removes only its staging directory.

baseline_debug.mixed_publication: Three of five focused cases fail with parent projection checksum entry is missing when Compact and its sibling parts are written separately.
baseline_debug.distinct_read_limits: An isolated Wide child of a Compact parent fails with Binary bulk reader transport budget differs from its read limits when staged readback receives the write limits.

native.layouts: Plain Compact MRK4 and adaptive Wide MRK2 with UInt64 and String. The Compact parent and Wide parts use String with_size_stream. The Compact child uses String single_stream.
native.observations: Both generated mixed pairs pass ATTACH PART and CHECK TABLE in both Crystal build modes. Direct parent and projection reads and forced projection queries match literal RowBinary. EXPLAIN names by_score in ReadFromMergeTree. All original files retain their hashes after ATTACH. Crystal reopens the attached parts and reads exact full rows and windows with the parent batch identity.

refresh_when: Rerun the guarded cohorts and native writer witness after changes to projection ownership, staging, checksum summaries, codec or transport budgets, the tested layout and schema, the toolchain, or ClickHouse. Rebuild the helpers from the sealed inputs and recorded commands.
